subject: Coordination: DPA review + pen-test kickoff and security demo
messages:
From: Sarah Holloway <sarah.holloway@fluxhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tom.berger@securetests.io>
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: DPA + pen-test intake and security walkthrough

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the intro earlier. We'd like to formalize next steps so our legal and infosec teams can sign off. High-level asks from our side: DPA review (we have a few redlines), SOC 2 attestation copy, and to schedule a short security walkthrough/demo for our platform engineers. We'll also be coordinating a third-party pen test and want to align scope.

Can you share:
- SOC 2 attestation (or the primary auditor contact)
- A clean DPA we can circulate to counsel
- A 45-minute slot next week for a combined walkthrough + intake call (infosec + engineering)

Available windows (PST):
- Tue 11/04: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 11/05: 09:00–12:00

Tom (cc) will be our pen-test vendor — happy to loop him into the intake.

Thanks,
Sarah Holloway
Head of IT Security
FluxHealth
(sarah.holloway@fluxhealth.com)

Attachments: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DPA + pen-test intake and security walkthrough

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear asks. Happy to get this moving. Quick notes and attachments in this email:
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2024.pdf (latest report) and Redwood_DPA_v3_clean.docx.
- We usually do a 30–45 minute intake call that covers DPA redlines, pen-test scope, and a short demo of our admin/controls (10–15 min).

Proposed times (PST) that work for our security engineer and me:
- Tue 11/04: 14:00–14:45 (preferred)
- Wed 11/05: 10:00–10:45

If either of those looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a proposed agenda (I attached a .ics stub as well). If you need a later time, we can also do Thu 11/06 morning.

Also: can you confirm whether FluxHealth needs evidence around data residency or specific logs retention windows so we can prep those docs before the call?

Thanks — looping in Marissa (solutions engineering) and Stephanie (legal ops) to help with any redline questions and the demo.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

- Yes please include any residency/logs doc if you have it; our compliance lead will want those.
- Tom (cc) — our plan is to share an initial scope matrix. Can you provide a point-of-contact at SecureTests for the scheduling + scoping?
